title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Program Schedule: Order Minimums, Deposits, Tenders and Pricing Bases
content:
Ridgeline Special Order Services runs six programs, and each program fixes its own order minimum, deposit at order, accepted tenders, eligibility for ProBuild volume pricing and price protection period. The figures below are the program values; the rules that use them are stated in the special order terms that name them.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Order minimum** — the smallest order total the program accepts, in US dollars.
- **Deposit percentage** — the deposit due when the order is placed, as a percentage of the order total; 100 means the order is paid in full at order.
- **Minimum deposit** — the smallest deposit due at order, in US dollars.
- **Accepted tenders** — the tenders the program accepts on the order.
- **ProBuild volume quote pricing** — whether the order may be priced under a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards volume pricing quote.
- **Price protection period** — the calendar days after the order date during which a lower vendor price on the same item is credited; 0 means the program has no price protection.

## Schedule

| Program | Order minimum (USD) | Deposit percentage | Minimum deposit (USD) | ProBuild volume quote pricing | Price protection period (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 25.00 | 100 | 0.00 | yes | 14 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 200.00 | 100 | 0.00 | yes | 0 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 50.00 | 100 | 0.00 | no | 0 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 300.00 | 50 | 250.00 | yes | 0 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 1500.00 | 50 | 500.00 | yes | 0 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 800.00 | 50 | 500.00 | yes | 0 |

**Accepted tenders, every program:** cash, check, bank card, a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account and a Ridgeline Pro Credit account. No program accepts a tender outside these five.

## Reading the schedule

**Which programs are paid in full when the order is placed?** The three programs with a deposit percentage of 100: Catalog Merchandise, Cut-to-Order Flooring and Made-to-Measure Window Coverings.

**Which programs take a deposit at order with the balance later?** The three programs with a deposit percentage of 50: Windows and Exterior Doors, Semi-Custom Cabinetry and Fabricated Countertops, each with the minimum deposit shown.

**Which program cannot be priced under a ProBuild volume quote?** Made-to-Measure Window Coverings; every other program may be.

**Which program has price protection?** Only Catalog Merchandise, with 14 calendar days; every other program shows 0, meaning none.
